prompt:
Write 8 short claim log entries (one to three sentences each) by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim, in time order. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1307; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- Nothing suggests the damage happened before the coverage started.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text:
Entry 1: Claim reported by the policyholder after a sideswipe on the highway during a lane change. The claimant, a passenger in the other vehicle, reports neck pain and has no lawyer representing them.

Entry 2: Reviewed the police report and the photos from the scene. The damage to both vehicles is mostly in line with the impact described, and the police confirm the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time.

Entry 3: Spoke with the other driver, who gave the same account of the lane change and the contact between the vehicles. Witness statements match this version of events.

Entry 4: Claimant was asked about prior injuries to the neck and upper back and reported none. No earlier injury to that body area is known from available records.

Entry 5: Claimant repeated the same account of the collision in each conversation so far. The reported neck strain is plausible for a sideswipe of this type.

Entry 6: Vehicle inspection completed. No earlier damage to the claimant's vehicle is known, and nothing suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.

Entry 7: Confirmed the driver of the policyholder's vehicle lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member under the policy.

Entry 8: Treatment for the neck strain followed a usual course and has tapered off as the claimant improved. Claim remains open pending final medical update.
